title: CIA-UAP-D022, Unidentified Flying Object Reported near Puerto Rico, 1965
doc_notes: This document consists of CIA memoranda regarding a 1964 UAP sighting near Puerto Rico, involving both visual and radar data. / This document is a CIA memorandum discussing a 1964 UAP sighting near Puerto Rico, featuring significant text degradation and illegibility. / This document is a CIA memorandum regarding the evaluation of radar data and reports of a high-speed unidentified object near Puerto Rico in November 1964.

incidents.summary: A U.S. Navy pilot observed a delta-shaped object near Puerto Rico, which was also tracked by the USS Gyatt's radar at high speeds.
incidents.explanation: The AD/SI suggested it was conceivably associated with foreign intelligence gathering activities.
incidents.quote: U.S. Navy pilot was able to distinguish the object as a delta shape about the size of a jet fighter.

incidents.summary: A U.S. Naval aviator and the USS Gyatt radar system tracked an unidentified delta-shaped object near Puerto Rico.
A U.S. Naval aviator observed a delta-shaped object estimated at Mach 3, while the USS Gyatt radar tracked it at 3,800 knots.
incidents.quote: delta-shaped, about the size of a jet fighter
